> Ever since i was a kid , i always wanted to make a drumPad but never got the chance to do so  and now i am here in Week 3(themed for an instrument) , so let's make it  IT will have 3x3 piezo disc , an esp32-s3 module , some push buttons ,an Oled 0.96inch , an i2s audio breakout board  Let's hope for the best

Hi hack club reviewers

In this 1.15hrs i was building a new hover up enclosure in my CAD file
where i extruded the hover off parts with 3.2mm hole and outer diameter with 5mm so that my M3 screws fit easily and was planning to how to tilt the plate and place it
After that i realized that part is not needed so i remove the supports and thinking how to make it without making the print weaker
